content:
iCloud+ keeps adding new perks for subscribers, including two that are coming with iOS 27.3 when it launches next month.

#1: Higher usage limits for Siri AI and other AI features

When iOS 27.3 beta 2 debuted earlier this week, we detailed how the update introduces AI usage limits for Siri AI and select other features.

For AI features that depend on server-based models, each device running iOS 27.3, iPadOS 27.3, or macOS 27.3 will have limited daily access to advanced AI features. These include complex Siri AI requests, Image Playground, certain Photos app editing tools, and more.

But most iCloud+ plans will now include significantly higher usage limits for subscribers. Here’s the breakdown:

  • 200GB plan: up to 2x higher daily limits
  • 2TB plan: up to 5x higher daily limits
  • 6TB plan: up to 10x higher daily limits
  • 12TB plan: up to 20x higher daily limits

The only iCloud+ tier that doesn’t include higher limits is the $0.99/month plan.

Read more: Apple reveals how iCloud+ increases Siri AI and Apple Intelligence usage limits

#2: Exclusive access to powerful Shortcuts feature

iOS 27.3 will also give most iCloud+ subscribers exclusive access to a powerful Shortcuts app feature.

In the Shortcuts app, the ‘Use Model’ action lets you choose between a few different model options, including Cloud, Cloud Pro, On-Device, and ChatGPT.

Top comment by GreenWrench

New perks? SiriAi was introduced without any identified user costs at all, that's the reference point.

So - what is the per device daily usage limit? It appears to be undefined, hence offering 2x, 5x, 10x, or 20x of this undefined value seems like a confusing value proposition.

The linked article mentions that the undefined usage limit is per device, but that the iCloud usage increases are per account. So this 'perk' is an increase over a single device usage limit or the aggregated limits of all your applicable devices?

I suppose the cost of buying increased SiriAi usage directly is still undefined as well? If the author has additional information on these questions, that would be appreciated.

But with iOS 27.3, access to the Cloud Pro model is limited to iCloud+ subscribers on the 200GB plan or higher. If you don’t have an iCloud+ plan, this model won’t be available.

Similar to Apple’s other AI usage limits, your access to the Cloud Pro model in Shortcuts increases if you have a higher storage plan. Per this support document, the 200GB plan supports standard limits, the 2TB plan offers 5x access, followed by 10x on the 6TB plan and 20x on the 12TB plan.

iCloud+ already provided far more than just increased cloud storage, but with iOS 27.3 it’s set to be an asset for AI power users too.

iCloud+ is available as a standalone subscription or through the Apple One bundle, which also includes Apple TV, Apple Music, and more.
